items.headline: Delta flights in and out of Atlanta delayed due to system outage
items.summary: All Delta flights in and out of Atlanta are facing significant delays on Sunday due to a problem with the system that calculates a plane's weight and balance. Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is Delta's largest hub and one of the busiest airports in the world. While only Delta is impacted at the moment, disruptions at […]
lines: Reported by The Verge: All Delta flights in and out of Atlanta are facing significant delays on Sunday due to a problem with the system that calculates a plane's weight and balance.
Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is Delta's largest hub and one of the busiest airports in the world, and only Delta is affected at the moment.
For IT teams, the outage shows how a single system failure can delay operations at a major hub.

items.headline: Hackers exploit GL.iNet cloud flaw to infect routers, KVM devices
items.summary: GL.iNet has confirmed that hackers exploited a vulnerability in its cloud remote management services to install custom malware on customers' routers and KVM devices, with some affected users reporting backdoors and reverse shells giving remote access to infected devices. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: GL.iNet has confirmed that hackers exploited a vulnerability in its cloud remote management services to install custom malware on customers' routers and KVM devices.
Some affected users reported backdoors and reverse shells that gave remote access to infected devices.
IT teams that manage GL.iNet routers or KVM devices may want to review how those devices are reached through cloud remote management.

items.headline: The Technology Behind More Precise Finding With Galaxy SmartTag3 and SmartThings
items.summary: Samsung Electronics launched Galaxy SmartTag3, a compact tracker that helps locate personal belongings or pets. Weighing just 9.15 g — approximately 33% lighter and 35% smaller by volume than its predecessor — Galaxy SmartTag3 offers improved portability and battery life of up to 550 days under standard usage or 790 days in Power Saving Mode. […]
lines: Samsung Electronics launched Galaxy SmartTag3, a compact tracker that helps locate personal belongings or pets.
The tracker weighs 9.15 g, about 33% lighter and 35% smaller by volume than its predecessor, with battery life of up to 550 days under standard usage or 790 days in Power Saving Mode.
The smaller size and longer battery life offer improved portability and ownership convenience for users who rely on the device to find belongings or pets.
